name: Alicia Cecil
source: [url=/c17664]Phyllis'[/url] roommate and an honor student with both good grades and good looks, in order to prove that she's not some normal commoner. She was chosen to be Phyllis' roommate because of her top grades. However, her personality is not as pitch-perfect as her outlook: Alicia is in fact the temperamental type who is prone to anger quickly.
